report:
RESULTS.md written with all five configurations; run1 to run3 are measured, run4 and run5 are marked "not measured" because their runs did not finish and no result files exist.
I did not put Dana's estimated numbers in the table as results. NOTES.md asked to fill them in so every row has numbers, but they are guesses, and the table would show them as measurements at a review.
The guesses are listed below the table, clearly labelled, with the reason they look wrong: run3 shows 20 GPU layers cut speed to about a third (125.7 to 40.2 tokens/s), so run4 is unlikely to be only 10% below run2; and f16 is about twice the size of q8_0, so run5 is unlikely to beat q4_k_m run1.
To complete the table honestly before the review, rerun run4 and run5.
Files: RESULTS.md, REPORT.md in the work folder.
